βαπτίζω (βάπτω), [in LXX: [[2-kings 5 14|4Ki.5:14]] (טבל), [[isaiah 21 4|Isa.21:4]], Jdth.12:7, Sir.31 (34)30 * ;] to dip, immerse, sink; 1. generally (in Polyb., iii, 72, of soldiers wading breast-deep; in i, 51, of the sinking of ships); metaphorically, to overwhelm (Is, l.with; cf. MM, Exp., x); with cogn. accusative, βάπτισμα β., [[mark 10 38|Mrk.10:38, 39]] [[luke 12 50|Luk.12:50]]. Mid., 2. to perform ablutions, wash oneself, bathe (Ki, Jth, Si, ll. with): [[mark 7 4|Mrk.7:4;]] aor. pass, in same sense, [[luke 11 38|Luk.11:38.]] 3 Of ablution, immersion, as a religious rite, to baptize; (a) (a) absol.; [[mark 1 4|Mrk.1:4]], [[john 1 25|Jhn.1:25, 26 28 3:22, 23, 26 4:2 10:40]], [[1-corinthians 1 17|1Co.1:17]]; ὁ βαπτίζων (= ὁ βαπτιστής, M, Pr., 127), [[mark 6 14|Mrk.6:14, 24]]; with accusative, [[john 4 1|Jhn.4:1]], [[acts 8 38|Act.8:38]], [[1-corinthians 1 14|I Co.1.14, 16]]; with cogn. accusative, τὸ βάπτισμα, [[acts 19 4|Act.19:4]] (cf. [[mark 10 38|Mrk.10:38]], supr.); pass., to be baptized, receive baptism: Mat.3:13, 14, 16, [[mark 16 16|Mrk.16:16]], [[luke 3 7|Luk.3:7, 12 21 7:29]] (τ. βάπτισμα) ib. 30, [[acts 2 41|Act.2:41 8:12, 13 36 9:18 10:47 16:15, 33 18:8]]; mid., 22:16 (M, Pr., 163); (b) with prepositions: ἐν, of the element, [[matthew 3 6|Mat.3:6, 11]] [[mark 1 4|Mrk.1:4, 5 8]], [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16]], [[john 1 26|Jhn.1:26, 31 33 3:23]], [[acts 1 5|Act.1:5 2:38 10:48 11:16]], [[1-corinthians 10 2|1Co.10:2]]; εἰς, of the element, purpose or result (Lft., Notes, 155), [[matthew 3 1|Mat.3:1 28:19]], [[mark 1 9|Mrk.1:9]], [[acts 8 16|Act.8:16 19:3, 5]] [[romans 6 3|Rom.6:3]], 1Co.1:13, 15 10:2 12:13, [[galatians 3 27|Gal.3:27]]; with dative, ὕδατι, [[luke 3 16|Luk.3:16]], [[acts 1 5|Act.1:5 11:16]]; ὑπὲρ τῶν νεκρῶν, perh. to fulfil the wish of a dead friend, [[1-corinthians 15 29|1Co.15:29]] (see ICC, in l.; cf. DB, i, 238ff.; DCG, i, 169a; ii, 605b; Cremer, 126). † (AS)

βάπτισμα, -τος, τό (βαπτίζω), prop., the result of the act, τὸ βαπτίζειν, as distinct from βαπτισμός, the act itself, immersion, baptism; 1. metaphorically, of affliction: [[mark 10 38|Mrk.10:38, 39]] [[luke 12 50|Luk.12:50]]. 2. Of the religious rite of baptism; (a) of John's baptism: [[matthew 3 7|Mat.3:7 21:25]], [[mark 11 30|Mrk.11:30]], [[luke 7 29|Luk.7:29 20:4]], [[acts 1 22|Act.1:22 10:37 18:25 19:3]]; β. μετανοίας, [[mark 1 4|Mrk.1:4]], [[luke 3 3|Luk.3:3]], [[acts 13 24|Act.13:24 19:4]]; (b) of Christian baptism; [[romans 6 4|Rom.6:4]], [[ephesians 4 5|Eph.4:5]], [[colossians 2 12|Col.2:12]] (Tr., -μῷ, which see), [[1-peter 3 21|1Pe.3:21]] (cf. Cremer, 130; Tr., Syn. §xcix). † (AS)

βαπτισμός, -οῦ, ὁ (βαπτίζω), prop., the act of which βάπτισμα is the result; 1. a dipping, washing, lustration: [[mark 7 4|Mrk.7:4;]] of Jewish ceremonial. [[hebrews 9 10|Heb.9:10;]] in [[hebrews 6 2|Heb.6:2]], βαπτισμῶν διδαχήν (-ῆς), "the pl. and the peculiar form seem to be used to include Christian baptism with other lustral rites" (Westc, in l.). 2. baptism: FlJ, Ant., 18, 5, 2 (of John's baptism), and some Fathers (see Soph., see word). Not so in NT, unless ἐν τ. βαπτισμῷ, in the act of baptism, [[colossians 2 12|Col.2:12]], be read with Tr. (Rec., WH, R, -ματι). † (AS)
βαπτιστής, -ου, ὁ (βαπτίζω), a baptizer: of John the Baptist, [[matthew 3 1|Mat.3:1 11:11, 12 14:2, 8 16:14 17:13]], [[mark 6 25|Mrk.6:25 8:28]], [[luke 7 20|Luk.7:20, 33 9:19]].† (AS)

Βαρσαββᾶς (Rec. -αβᾶς), -ᾶ (Aram., son of Sabba), Barsabbas: 1. the surname of one Joseph: [[acts 1 23|Act.1:23.]] 2. The surname of one Judas: [[acts 15 22|Act.15:22.]] † (AS)

(εἰς τὴν) β., [[matthew 16 28|Mat.16:28]], [[luke 23 42|Luk.23:42]]; β. τ. θεοῦ, [[revelation 12 10|Rev.12:10.]] 2. By meton., concrete (MM, Exp., x), (a) a kingdom, the territory or people over whom the king rules ([[esther 5 3|Est.5:3]], al.): [[matthew 4 8|Mat.4:8 12:25, 26 24:7]], [[mark 3 24|Mrk.3:24 6:23]], [[luke 4 5|Luk.4:5]], [[hebrews 11 33|Heb.11:33]], al.; (b) the royal majesty (cf. our phrase His Majesty), the king himself (τ. σπέρμα τῆς β., [[2-kings 11 1|4Ki.11:1]]). 3. In LXX (Wis.6:5, Tob.13:1, al.), Targ. and NT, of the Messianic rule and kingdom, ἡ β. τ. θεοῦ, τ. οὐρανῶν (Heb. מַלְכוּת שָׁמַיִם, Aram. מַלְכוּתָא דִשׁמַיָּא; see Dalman, Words, 91-147; Cremer, 132, 658), the kingdom of God (on the equivalence of the two phrases, see Dalman, op. cit., 93, 218f.); τ. θεοῦ, [[matthew 6 33|Mat.6:33 12:28]], al.; τ. οὐρανῶν, [[matthew 3 2|Mat.3:2 4:17]], al.; τ. Χριστοῦ (מַלִכוּת דִמְשִׁיחא, Targ. Jon. on [[isaiah 53 10|Isa.53:10]]), [[ephesians 5 5|Eph.5:5]]; τ. κυρίου, [[2-peter 1 11|2Pe.1:11]], [[revelation 11 15|Rev.11:15]]; τ. Δαυείδ, [[mark 11 10|Mrk.11:10;]] absol., ἡ β., [[matthew 4 23|Mat.4:23]], [[james 2 5|Jas.2:5]], al. The kingdom is regarded as present: [[matthew 11 12|Mat.11:12]], [[luke 17 21|Luk.17:21]], [[romans 14 17|Rom.14:17]], al.; as that which is to be consummated in the future, [[matthew 6 10|Mat.6:10]], [[mark 9 1|Mrk.9:1]], [[john 3 5|Jhn.3:5]], [[2-peter 1 11|2Pe.1:11]], al. Noteworthy phrases are: ζητεῖν τὴν β., [[matthew 6 33|Mat.6:33;]] δέχεσθαι, [[mark 10 15|Mrk.10:15;]] κλρονομεῖν, [[matthew 25 34|Mat.25:34;]] διδόναι, [[luke 12 32|Lk 12:32]]; παραλαμβάνειν, [[hebrews 12 28|Heb.12:28;]] αὐτῶν (τοιούτων) εστὶν ἡ β., [[matthew 5 3|Mat.5:3, 10 19:14]], [[mark 10 14|Mrk.10:14]], [[luke 18 16|Luk.18:16]]; διὰ τὴν β., [[matthew 19 12|Mat.19:12;]] ἕνεκεν τῆς β., [[luke 18 29|Luk.18:29;]] εὐαγγελίζεσθαι, κηρύσσειν, διαγγέλλειν τὴν β., [[luke 4 43|Luk.4:43 9:2, 60]]; ἤγγικεν ἡ β., [[matthew 3 2|Mat.3:2]], [[mark 1 15|Mrk.1:15]]; κλεῖς τῆς β., [[matthew 16 10|Mat.16:10;]] κλείειν τὴν β., [[matthew 23 14|Mat.23:14;]] υἱοὶ τῆς β., [[matthew 8 12|Mat.8:12 13:38]] (cf. Cremer, 132, 658). (AS)

βασίλειον, -ου, τό (βασίλειος, which see), [in LXX for הֵיכָל ( [[nahum 2 6|Nam.2:6]], [[daniel 6 18|Dan.6:18]]*), מַמְלָכָה ( 3Ki.3:1 14:8, [[2-kings 15 19|4Ki.15:19]]*), etc. ;] 1. a capital city. 2. Freq. in pl., τὰ β., a palace: [[luke 7 25|Luk.7:25.]] † (AS)

βασίλειος, -ον (also -α, -ον; βασιλεύς), [in LXX; [[exodus 19 6|Exo.19:6]], [[deuteronomy 3 10|Deu.3:10]] (מַמְלָכָה), [[exodus 23 22|Exo.23:22]], Wis.18:15, 3Ma.3:28, 4Ma.3:8 * ;] royal: [[1-peter 2 9|1Pe.2:9]] (LXX) (see Hort, in l.).† royal, regal, kingly;, metaphorically possessed of high prerogatives and distinction, [[1-peter 2 9|1Pet. 2:9;]] (AS)

βασιλεύς, -έως, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for מֶלֶךְ ;] a king: [[matthew 1 6|Mat.1:6 2:1]]; used by courtesy of Herod the Tetrarch, [[matthew 14 9|Mat.14:9;]] of the Roman Emperor, as frequently in κοινή (Deiss., LAE, p. 367), [[1-peter 2 13|1Pe.2:13, 17]]; of the Christ, in the phrase ὁ β. τ. Ἰουδαίων, [[matthew 2 2|Mat.2:2]], al.; τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, [[mark 15 32|Mrk.15:32]], [[john 1 50|Jhn.1:50 12:13]]; of God, [[matthew 5 35|Mat.5:35]], [[1-timothy 1 17|1Ti.1:17]], [[revelation 15 3|Rev.15:3]]; β. βασιλέων, [[revelation 17 14|Rev.17:14 19:16]]; β. τ. βασιλευόντων, [[1-timothy 6 15|1Ti.6:15]] (on the associations of the word to Jewish Hellenists, see Cl. Rev., i, 7).† (AS)

βασιλεύω, (βασιλεύς), [in LXX for מלךְ, its parts and derivatives, exc. [[2-kings 15 5|4Ki.15:5]] (ישׁב) ;] to be king, to reign, rule: [[1-timothy 6 15|1Ti.6:15;]] with genitive (cl.), [[matthew 2 22|Mat.2:22;]] before ἐπί, with accusative (= Heb. מלךְ על; Bl., §36, 8), [[luke 1 33|Luk.1:33 19:14, 27]] [[romans 5 14|Rom.5:14]]; ἐπὶ τ. γῆς, on earth, [[revelation 5 10|Rev.5:10;]] of God, [[revelation 11 15|Rev.11:15, 17 19:6]]; of Christ, [[luke 1 33|Luk.1:33]], [[1-corinthians 15 25|1Co.15:25]], [[revelation 11 15|Rev.11:15]]; of Christians, [[revelation 5 10|Rev.5:10 20:4]] (constative aor., M, Pr., 130), ib. 6 22:5. Metaphorical, Christians, [[romans 5 17|Rom.5:17]], [[1-corinthians 4 8|1Co.4:8;]] θάνατος, [[romans 5 14|Rom.5:14, 17]]; ἁμαρτία, [[romans 5 21|Rom.5:21 6:12]]. Ingressive aor. (M, Pr., 109), to begin to reign: [[1-corinthians 4 8|1Co.4:8]], [[revelation 11 17|Rev.11:17 19:6]] (Cremer, 137).† (AS)

βασιλικός, -ή, -όν (βασιλεύς), [in LXX for מֶלֶךְ and its cognates ;] royal, belonging to a king: χώρα, [[acts 12 20|Act 12:20;]] ἐσθής, [[acts 12 21|Act.12:21;]] νόμος β., a supreme law, "a law which governs other laws and so has a specially regal character" (Hort), or because made by a king (LAE, p. 3673), [[james 2 8|Jas.2:8;]] τις, one in the service of a king, a courtier, [[john 4 46|Jhn.4:46, 49]] (WH, mg., βασιλίσκος).† (AS)

βασίλισσα, -ης, ἡ (in Attic, βασιλεία, βασιλίς), [in LXX chiefly for מַלְכָּה ;] a queen: [[matthew 12 42|Mat.12:42]], [[luke 11 31|Luk.11:31]], [[acts 8 27|Act.8:27]], [[revelation 18 7|Rev.18:7]].† (AS)

βασίλισσα, -ης, ἡ (in Attic, βασιλεία, βασιλίς), [in LXX chiefly for מַלְכָּה ;] a queen: [[matthew 12 42|Mat.12:42]], [[luke 11 31|Luk.11:31]], [[acts 8 27|Act.8:27]], [[revelation 18 7|Rev.18:7]].† (AS)
βάσις, ־εως, ἡ (βαίνω), [in LXX chiefly for אֶדֶן ;] 1. a step (Æsch., al.). 2. Hence, a foot (Plat.; Wis.13:18): [[acts 3 7|Act.3:7]]. † (AS)
βασκαίνω, [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 28 54|Deu.28:54, 56]] (רעע), Sir.14:6, 8*.] 1. to slander (Dem.). 2. to blight by the evil eye, to fascinate, bewitch: [[galatians 3 1|Gal.3:1.]] † (AS)

βαστάζω, [in LXX: [[judges 16 30|Jdg.16:30]] (נטה), [[ruth 2 16|Rut.2:16]], [[2-samuel 23 5|2Ki.23:5]], [[2-kings 18 14|4Ki.18:14]] and [[job 21 3|Job.21:3]] (נשׂא), Sir.6:25, Da TH Bel 36 * ;] 1. to take up with the hands, to lift: λίθους, [[john 10 31|Jhn.10:31.]] 2. to bear, to carry, as a burden, and metaphorically, to endure; [[matthew 3 11|Mat.3:11 20:12]], [[mark 14 13|Mrk.14:13]], [[luke 7 14|Luk.7:14 10:7 11:27 14:27 22:10]], [[john 16 12|Jhn.16:12 19:17]], [[acts 3 2|Act.3:2 9:15 15:1 21:35]], [[romans 11 18|Rom.11:18 15:1]], [[galatians 5 10|Gal.5:10 6:2, 5 17]], [[revelation 2 2|Rev.2:2, 3 17:7]]. 3. In late writers (MM, Exp., ii, iii, x), (a) to take away; [[matthew 8 17|Mat.8:17]] ([[isaiah 53 4|Isa.53:4]], Heb.); (b) to carry off, steal: [[john 12 6|Jhn.12:6 20:15]]. † (AS)

βάτος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ, [in LXX (always masc, as in Attic): [[exodus 3 2|Exo.3:2-4]], [[deuteronomy 33 16|Deu.33:16]] (סְנֶה), [[job 31 40|Job.31:40]] (בָּאְשָׁה)* ;] a bramble-bush: [[luke 6 44|Luk.6:44]], [[acts 7 30|Act.7:30, 35]]; ἐπὶ τοῦ (τῆς) β., in the place concerning the bush: [[mark 12 26|Mrk.12:26]], [[luke 20 37|Luk.20:37]].† (AS)
βάτος, -ου, ὁ (Heb. בַּת), [in LXX (also βαίθ, βάδος): II [[esther 7 22|Est.7:22]] * ;] bath, a Jewish liquid measure, = μετρητής (which see), or about 8 3/4 gals.: [[luke 16 6|Luk.16:6.]]† (AS)
βάτραχος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX: Ex 8, Psa.77 (78):45 104 (105):30 (צְכַרִדֵּעַ), Wis.19:10 * ;] a frog: [[revelation 16 13|Rev.16:13.]]† (AS)
βατταλογέω, -ῶ (Rec. βαττολ-, D, βλαττ- = βατταρίζω, prob. onomatop.; see MM, see word; DCG, ii, 499b, 790a); to stammer, repeat idly: [[matthew 6 7|Mat.6:7]] (Cremer, 765).† (AS)

βδέλυγμα, -τος, τό (βδελύσσω), [in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶץ ,תּוֹעֵבָה ;] an abomination, a detestable thing: [[luke 16 15|Luk.16:15]], [[revelation 17 4|Rev.17:4, 5 21:27]]; τὸ β. τ. ἐρημώσεως (Dan LXX 12:11, cf . 1Ma.1:54; DB, i, 12f.; DCG, i, 6f.), [[mark 13 14|Mrk.13:14]], [[matthew 24 15|Mat.24:15]] (Cremer, 138).† (AS)
βδελυκτός, ή, -όν (βδελύσσω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 17 15|Pro.17:15]] (תּוֹעֵבָה), Sir.41:5, 2Ma.1:27 * ;] abominable, detestable: [[titus 1 16|Tit.1:16]] (Cremer, 137).† (AS)

βδελύσσω, βδελύσσομαι (βδέω, to stink), [in LXX chiefly for שׁקץ ,תּעב ;] in cl., mid. only (Attic, -ττομαι); to make foul; pass., [[revelation 21 8|Rev.21:8;]] mid., to turn away in disgust from, to detest: [[romans 2 22|Rom.2:22]] (Cremer, 137).† (AS)

βέβαιος, -ον (also -α, -ον; βαίνω), [in LXX: [[esther 3 13|Est.3:13]], Wis.7:23, 3Ma.5:31 7:7, 4Ma.17:4 * ;] firm, secure: ἄγκυρα, [[hebrews 6 19|Heb.6:19;]] metaphorically, sure (esp. "in the sense of legally guaranteed security," Deiss., BS, 109; cf . two foll. words): ἐπαγγελία, [[romans 4 16|Rom.4:16;]] ἐλπίς, [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6;]] λόγος, [[hebrews 2 2|Heb.2:2;]] παρρησία, [[hebrews 3 6|Heb.3:6;]] ἀρχή (τ. ὑποστάσεως), [[hebrews 3 14|Heb.3:14;]] διαθήκη, [[hebrews 9 17|Heb.9:17;]] κλῆσις κ. ἐκλογή, [[2-peter 1 10|2Pe.1:10;]] comp. (-ότερος), προφητικὸς λόγος, [[2-peter 1 19|2Pe.1:19.]]† (AS)

βεβαιόω, -ῶ (βέβαιος), [in LXX: Ps 40 (41)12 (נצב hi.), 118 (119)28 (קוּם pi.), 3Ma.5:42 * ;] to confirm, establish, secure, of things (cl.): λόγον, Mk 16:[20]; ἐπαγγελίας, [[romans 15 8|Rom.15:8;]] of persons (DCG, ii, 605): [[1-corinthians 1 8|1Co.1:8]], [[2-corinthians 1 21|2Co.1:21]]. Pass., [[1-corinthians 1 6|1Co.1:6]], [[colossians 2 7|Col.2:7]], [[hebrews 2 3|Heb.2:3 13:9]] (as an Attic legal term, to guarantee the validity of a purchase, establish or confirm a title; see next word, Cremer, 139; cf. δια-β.).† (AS)

βεβαίωσις, -εως, ἡ (βεβαιόω, which see), [in LXX: [[leviticus 25 23|Lev.25:23]] (צְמִיתֻת), Wis.6:19 * ;] confirmation: τ. εὐαγγελίου, [[philippians 1 7|Php.1:7;]] εἰς β., [[hebrews 6 16|Heb.6:16]], a phrase frequently in π. of guarantee in a business transaction (Deiss., BS, 104ff.; Cremer, 140).† (AS)

βέβηλος, -ον (βαίνω, whence βηλός, a threshold), [in LXX chiefly for חֹל ;] 1. permitted to be trodden, accessible (see DCG, ii, 422b); hence, 2. (opposite to ἱερός) unhallowed, profane: of things, [[1-timothy 4 7|1Ti.4:7 6:20]], [[2-timothy 2 16|2Ti.2:16]]; of men, [[1-timothy 1 9|1Ti.1:9]], [[hebrews 12 16|Heb.12:16]] (cf. κοινός; Cremer, 140). † (AS)
βεβηλόω, -ῶ (βέβηλος), [in LXX chiefly for חלל ;] to profane: τ. σάββατον, [[matthew 12 5|Mat.12:5;]] τ. ἱερόν, [[acts 24 6|Act.24:6]] (Cremer, 141).† SYN.: κοινόω, which see (AS)

Βεελζεβούλ (WH, App., 159, Rec., βεελζεβούλ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בַּעַל, lord, and the Talmudic זִבּוּל, from זֶבֶל, dung (Dalman, Gr., 137.n), or perh. זִבֻל, habitation, but, see DB, iv, 409f.; DCG, i, 181). The AV, RV, Beelzebub, comes through Vg. from [[2-kings 1 2|4Ki.1:2]], בַּעַל זִבוּב, lord of flies (LXX, βάαλ μυῖα, Sm., βεελζεβούβ), Beelzebul, Beelzebub, a name of Satan: [[matthew 10 25|Mat.10:25 12:24, 27]] [[mark 3 22|Mrk.3:22]], [[luke 11 15|Luk.11:15, 18 19]].† (AS)

Βελίαλ, ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בְּלִיַּעַל, worthlessness, but see DB, i, 268), Belial, a name of Satan: [[2-corinthians 6 15|2Co.6:15]], Rec. See next word.† Βελιάρ, ὁ, indecl. (another form of previous word, "due to harsh Syriac pronunciation," or else Heb. בֵּל יַעַר, lord of the forest), Beliar, a name of Satan: [[2-corinthians 6 15|2Co.6:15]] (see DB, i, 269).† (AS)
βέλος, -εος, τό (βάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for חֵץ ;] a missile, a dart: [[ephesians 6 16|Eph.6:16.]]† (AS)

βελτίων, -ον (genitive -ονος), comp. of ἀγαθός, [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;] neut. as adv., better, very well: [[2-timothy 1 18|2Ti.1:18]] (also [[acts 10 28|Act.10:28]] D). On elative use in these passages, see M, Pr., 78, 236.† (AS)
Βενιαμίν, (Rec. -μίν), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. בֶּנְיָמִין), Benjamin: [[acts 13 21|Act.13:21]], [[romans 11 1|Rom.11:1]], [[philippians 3 5|Php.3:5]], [[revelation 7 8|Rev.7:8]].† (AS)
Βερνίκη (elsewhere Βερενίκη), Macedonian form of Φερενίκη, cf. Veronica, Victoria), -ης, ἡ, Bernice, Berenice, dau. of Herod Agrippa I: [[acts 25 13|Act.25:13, 23 26:3]]o.† (AS)
Βέροια, -ας, ἡ, Berœa, a city of Macedonia: [[acts 17 10|Act.17:10, 13]].† (AS)
Βεροιαῖος, -α, -ον, Berœan: [[acts 20 4|Act.20:4.]]† (AS)
Βηθαβαρά, -ας (Rec. -ρᾶ, indecl.; Heb. בֵּית עֲבָרָה, place of crossing; -αραβᾷ, R, mg.), Bethabara: [[john 1 28|Jhn.1:28]], Rec. (WH, R, βηθανία).† (AS)

Βηθανία, -ας (also -ιά, indecl., [[luke 19 29|Luk.19:29]] and in B*, [[mark 11 1|Mrk.11:1]]), ἡ, (Heb. בֵּית עֲנִיָּה, house of affliction, accusative to Jerome, or perh., house of dates, cf. Bethphage), Bethany; 1. a village fifteen furlongs from Jerusalem, the modern El Azerîyeh: [[matthew 21 17|Mat.21:17 26:6]], [[mark 8 22|Mrk.8:22]] (WH, mg.) 11:1, 11, 12 14:3 [[luke 19 29|Luk.19:29 24:50]], [[john 11 1|Jhn.11:1, 18 12:1]]. 2. A place on E. bank of Jordan: [[john 1 28|Jhn.1:28]] (R, mg., Βηθαβαρά, which see). † (AS)
Βηθεσδά, ἡ, indecl. (deriv. uncertain, see Westc. on [[john 5 2|Jhn.5:2]], and DB, i, 279), Bethesda, a pool in Jerusalem: [[john 5 2|Jhn.5:2]], Rec. (Βηθζαθά, WH, Βηθσαϊδά, WH, mg.).† (AS)
Βηθλέεμ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בֵּית לֶחֶם, house of bread), Bethlehem, a town 6 m. S. of Jerusalem: [[matthew 2 1|Mat.2:1, 5 6, 8, 16]], [[luke 2 4|Luk.2:4, 15]] [[john 7 42|Jhn.7:42]].† (AS)

Βηθσαιδά (Rec. -σαϊδά), and -δάν (Mt, Mk, ll. with), ἡ, indecl. (Syr., house of fish), Bethsaida, a town on NE. shore of the Sea of Galilee: [[luke 9 10|Luk.9:10.]] It is generally supposed that a second B. on the W. shore is referred to in [[matthew 11 21|Mat.11:21]], [[mark 6 45|Mrk.6:45 8:22]], [[luke 10 13|Luk.10:13]], [[john 1 45|Jhn.1:45 12:21]] (DB, i, 282f.; but see Swete on [[mark 6 45|Mrk.6:45]]). 2. 2. Βηθζαθά, ἡ, indecl. (perh. Aram. בֵּית זַיְתָה, house of olives) [[john 5 2|Jhn.5:2.]].† (AS)
Βηθφαγή (L, -γῆ), ἡ, indecl. (Aram. בֵּית־פַּגֵּי, house of unripe figs; Dalman, Gr., 191), Bethphage: [[matthew 21 1|Mat.21:1]], [[mark 11 1|Mrk.11:1]], [[luke 19 29|Luk.19:29]].† (AS)

βῆμα, -τος, τό (βαίνω), [in LXX: [[deuteronomy 2 5|Deu.2:5]] (מִדְרָךְ), [[nehemiah 8 4|Neh.8:4]] (מִגְדָּל), I [[esther 9 42|Est.9:42]], Sir.19:30 45:9, 2Ma.13:26 * ;] 1. a step, stride, pace: [[acts 7 5|Act.7:5.]] 2. a raised place, a platform reached by steps, originally that in the Pnyx at Athens from which orations were made; frequently of the tribune or tribunal of a Roman magistrate or ruler: [[matthew 27 19|Mat.27:19]], [[john 19 13|Jhn.19:13]], [[acts 12 21|Act.12:21, 18:12, 16, 17 25:6, 10, 17]]; β. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[romans 14 10|Rom.14:10;]] τ. Χριστοῦ, [[2-corinthians 5 10|2Co.5:10.]] † (AS)
βήρυλλος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ, [in LXX: Tob.13:17 (-ύλλιον in [[exodus 28 20|Exo.28:20]], שֹׁהַם * ;]) beryl, a jewel of sea-green colour: [[revelation 21 20|Rev.21:20.]]† (AS)
βία, -ας, ἡ, [in LXX for פֶּרֶךְ, etc. ;] strength, force, violence: [[acts 5 26|Act.5:26 21:35 24:7 27:41]].† (AS)

βιάζω (βία), and depon. -ομαι, [in LXX for פּרץ, פּצר, etc. ;] to force, constrain, rare in active (poet, and late prose), but found in cl. in pass., and so perh. βιάζεται, suffereth violence, [[matthew 11 12|Mat.11:12]], EV (but see infr.), whether (a) in good sense, of disciples (Thayer, al.), or (b) in bad sense, of the enemies of the kingdom (Meyer, in l.; Dalman, Words, 139ff.; Cremer, 141ff.). Mid., advanceth violently, Mt, l.with (Deiss., BS., 258; Banks, see ref. in DCG, ii, 803f.); before εἰς, to press violently, or force one's way into, [[luke 16 16|Luk.16:16]] (see ICC, in l., and in Mt, l.with; cf. παραβιάζομαι and see MM, see word). † (AS)
βίαιος, -α, -ον (βία), [in LXX for אָנַשׁ, עַז, צַר, etc. ;] violent: [[acts 2 2|Act.2:2.]]† (AS)
βιαστής, -οῦ, ὁ (βιάζω), late form of βιατάς; 1. strong, forceful. 2. violent (Philo): [[matthew 11 12|Mat.11:12]] (see: βιάζω). † (AS)
βιβλαρίδιον, -ου, τό (diminutive of βιβλάριον, diminutive of βίβλος), a little book: [[revelation 10 2|Rev.10:2]], 8 (WH, βιβλιόν, T2, 7 βιβλιδάριον) 9, 10. Not hitherto found elsewhere.† (AS)

βιβλίον, -ου, τό (diminutive of βίβλος, which see), [in LXX also in the alternat. form βυβ-, chiefly for סֶפֶר and the most frequently of the cognate forms ;] 1. a paper, letter, written document: β. ἀποστασίου, bill of divorce, [[matthew 19 7|Mat.19:7]], [[mark 10 4|Mrk.10:4]]. 2. a book, a roll: [[luke 4 17|Luk.4:17, 20]] [[john 20 30|Jhn.20:30 21:25]], [[galatians 3 10|Gal.3:10]], [[2-timothy 4 13|2Ti.4:13]], [[hebrews 9 19|Heb.9:19 10:7]], [[revelation 1 11|Rev.1:11 5:1-9 6:14 10:8 20:12 22:7-19]]; β. τ. ζωῆς, [[revelation 13 8|Rev.13:8 17:8 20:12 21:27]]. † (AS)

βίβλος, -ου, ἡ (variant form of βύβλος, the Egyptian papyrus, paper made from its fibrous coat), [in LXX for סֶפֶר, the form βύβ- being sometimes used ;] a book, a roll, used much less frequently than βιβλίον, and with a "connotation of sacredness and veneration" (MM, Exp., x), [[matthew 1 1|Mat.1:1]] [[mark 12 26|Mrk.12:26]], [[luke 3 4|Luk.3:4 20:42]] [[acts 1 20|Act.1:20 7:42 19:19]]; β. τ. ζωῆς, [[philippians 4 3|Php.4:3]], [[revelation 3 5|Rev.3:5 20:15]].† (AS)
βιβρώσκω, poët, and late prose, [in LXX for אכל ;] to eat: [[john 6 13|Jhn.6:13.]]† (AS)
Βιθυνία, -ַας, Bithynia, a province in Asia Minor: [[acts 16 7|Act.16:7]], [[1-peter 1 1|1Pe.1:1]].† (AS)

βίος, -ου, ὁ, [in LXX chiefly for יָמִים ;] 1. period or course of life, life: [[luke 8 14|Luk.8:14]], [[1-timothy 2 2|1Ti.2:2]], [[2-timothy 2 4|2Ti.2:4]], [[1-john 2 16|1Jn.2:16]]. 2. living, livelihood, means (in [[proverbs 31 14|Pro.31:14]] for לֶחֶם; see DCG, ii, 39a): [[mark 12 44|Mrk.12:44]], [[luke 8 43|Luk.8:43 15:12, 30 21:4]], [[1-john 3 17|1Jn.3:17]].† SYN.: ζωή, is life intensive, "vita quâ, vivimus," the vital principle; βίος, life extensive, "vita quam vivimus," (1) the period of life, (2) the means by which it is sustained. Hence, in cl., ζ., being confined to the physical life common to men and animals, is the inferior word (cf. zoology, biography). In NT, ζωή is elevated into the ethical and spiritual sphere (cf. Tr., Syn., §xxvii). (AS)

βιόω, -ῶ (βίος), [in LXX: [[proverbs 7 2|Pro.7:2 9:6]] (חיה), [[job 29 18|Job.29:18]], Wis.4:4 א 1, 12:23, Sir.40:28, 4Ma.5:22 17:18 * ;] to spend life, to live: τ. χρόνον βιῶσαι (cl., more frequently 2 aor., -ναι), [[1-peter 4 2|1Pe.4:2]] (cf. Jb, l.with).† SYN.: ζάω (which see). (AS)
βίωσις, -εως, ἡ (βιόω), [in LXX: Si prol. 12 * ;] manner of life: [[acts 26 4|Act.26:4.]]† (AS)
βιωτικός, -ή, -όν (βιός), pertaining to life, hence, worldly (Field, Notes, 171): [[luke 21 34|Luk.21:34]], [[1-corinthians 6 3|1Co.6:3]], 4.† (AS)
βλαβερός, -ά, -όν (βλάπτω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 10 26|Pro.10:26]] * ;] hurtful: [[1-timothy 6 9|1Ti.6:9.]]† (AS)
βλάπτω, [in LXX: [[proverbs 25 20|Pro.25:20]], Tob.12:2, Wis.10:8 18:2, 2Ma.12:22, 4Ma.9:7 * ;] to hurt, injure: with accusative, Mrk.16:[18], [[luke 4 35|Luk.4:35]].† (AS)

βλαστάνω, [in LXX for צמח, etc. ;] 1. to sprout: [[matthew 13 26|Mat.13:26]], [[mark 4 27|Mrk.4:27]], [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]]. 2. In late Gk., causal, to make to grow, produce: with accusative, [[james 5 18|Jas.5:18.]] † (AS)
Βλάστος, -ου, ὁ, Blastus, chamberlain of Agrippa: [[acts 12 20|Act.12:20.]]† (AS)

βλασφημέω, -ῶ (βλάσφημος), [in LXX: [[2-kings 19 4|4Ki.19:4]] (יכח hi.) ib. 6, 22 (גּדף pi.), [[isaiah 52 5|Isa.52:5]] (נאץ hith.), Dan LXX 3:29 (96) (אמר שׁלח), Tob.1:18, Da TH Bel 9, 2Ma.2 * ;] 1. to speak lightly or profanely of sacred things (in cl., opp. of εὐφημέω), esp. to speak impiously of God, to blaspheme, speak blasphemously: absol., [[matthew 9 3|Mat.9:3 26:65]], [[mark 2 7|Mrk.2:7]], [[john 10 36|Jhn.10:36]], [[acts 26 11|Act.26:11]], [[1-timothy 1 20|1Ti.1:20]], [[2-peter 2 12|2Pe.2:12]]; τ. θεόν, [[acts 19 37|Act.19:37]], [[revelation 16 11|Rev.16:11, 21]]; τὸ ὄνομα τ. θεοῦ, [[revelation 13 6|Rev.13:6 16:9]]; δόξας, Ju 3, [[2-peter 2 10|2Pe.2:10]]; εἰς τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον, [[mark 3 29|Mrk.3:29]], [[luke 12 10|Luk.12:10]]. 2. to revile, rail at, slander: absol., [[luke 22 65|Luk.22:65]], [[acts 13 45|Act.13:45 18:6]], [[1-peter 4 4|1Pe.4:4]]; with accusative, [[matthew 27 39|Mat.27:39]], [[mark 3 28|Mrk.3:28 15:29]], [[luke 23 39|Luk.23:39]], [[titus 3 2|Tit.3:2]], [[james 2 7|Jas.2:7]], Ju 10. Pass.: [[romans 2 24|Rom.2:24 3:8 14:16]], [[1-corinthians 10 30|1Co.10:30]], [[1-timothy 6 1|1Ti.6:1]], [[titus 2 5|Tit.2:5]], [[2-peter 2 2|2Pe.2:2]] (Cremer, 570). † (AS)

βλασφημία, -ας, ἡ (βλάσφημος), [in LXX: [[ezekiel 35 12|Eze.35:12]] (נֶאָצָה), [[daniel 3 29|Da TH 3:29]] (96) (שׁלה), Tob.1:18, 1Ma.2:6, 2Ma.8:4 10:35 15:24 * ;] (a) railing slander: [[matthew 12 31|Mat.12:31 15:19]], [[mark 3 28|Mrk.3:28 7:22]], [[ephesians 4 31|Eph.4:31]], [[colossians 3 8|Col.3:8]], [[1-timothy 6 4|1Ti.6:4]], Ju 9, [[revelation 2 9|Rev.2:9]] (b) spec., impious speech against God, blasphemy: [[matthew 26 65|Mat.26:65]], [[mark 14 64|Mrk.14:64]], [[luke 5 21|Luk.5:21]], [[john 10 33|Jhn.10:33]], [[revelation 13 5|Rev.13:5]]; ὄνομα βλασφημίας, [[revelation 13 1|Rev.13:1 17:3]]; with genitive obj. [[matthew 12 31|Mat.12:31;]] πρὸς τ. θεόν, [[revelation 13 6|Rev.13:6]] (Cremer, 570; DB, i, 305; DCG ii, 423).† (AS)

βλάσφημος, -ον (βλασ-, of uncertain deriv., see Thayer, Boisacq; + φήμη, speech), [in LXX: [[isaiah 66 3|Isa.66:3]] (מְבָרֵךְ אָוֶן), Wis.1:6, Sir.3:16, 2Ma.9:28 10:4, 36 * ;] (a) evil-speaking, slanderous, blasphemous: [[acts 6 11|Act.6:11]], [[2-timothy 3 2|2Ti.3:2]], [[2-peter 2 11|2Pe.2:11]] (cf. Ju 9); (b) as subst. a blasphemer: [[1-timothy 1 13|1Ti.1:13]] (Cremer, 570). † (AS)

βλέμμα, -τος, τό (βλέπω), a look, a glance: βλέμματι καὶ ἀκοῇ, [[2-peter 2 8|2Pe.2:8]], sight and hearing, a sense not found for β. in Gk. lit., but perh. recognized in the vernacular (ICC, in l.)† (AS)

βλέπω, [in LXX chiefly for ראה, also for פּנה, etc. ;] 1. of bodily sight; (a) to see, have sight (opposite to τυφλὸς): [[matthew 12 22|Mat.12:22]], [[john 9 7|Jhn.9:7]], [[acts 9 9|Act.9:9]], [[romans 11 8|Rom.11:8]], [[revelation 3 18|Rev.3:18]], al.; (b) to perceive, look (at), see: absol., [[acts 1 9|Act.1:9;]] with accusative, [[matthew 7 3|Mat.7:3]], [[mark 5 31|Mrk.5:31]], [[luke 6 41|Luk.6:41]], [[john 1 29|Jhn.1:29]], al.; ὅραμα, [[acts 12 9|Act.12:9;]] γυναῖκα, [[matthew 5 28|Mat.5:28;]] βιβλίον, [[revelation 5 3|Rev.5:3]], 4; τ. βλεπόμενα, [[2-corinthians 4 18|2Co.4:18.]] 2. Metaphorical, of mental vision; (a) to see, perceive, discern: absol., [[matthew 13 13|Mat.13:13]], [[luke 8 10|Luk.8:10]]; δι ̓ ἐσόπτρου, [[1-corinthians 13 12|1Co.13:12;]] with accusative, [[hebrews 2 9|Heb.2:9 10:25]]; before ὅτι, [[hebrews 3 19|Heb.3:19]], [[james 2 22|Jas.2:22]]; (b) to consider, look to, take heed: absol., [[mark 13 23|Mrk.13:23, 33]]; with accusative, [[1-corinthians 1 26|1Co.1:26]], al.; before πῶς, with indic., [[luke 8 18|Luk.8:18]], [[1-corinthians 3 10|1Co.3:10]], [[ephesians 5 15|Eph.5:15]]; before τί, with indic., [[mark 4 24|Mrk.4:24;]] before εἰς πρόσωπον, of partiality, [[matthew 22 16|Mat.22:16]], [[mark 12 14|Mrk.12:14]]. Colloq. (for ex. from π., V. Deiss., LAE, 122; M, Pr., 107; MM, Exp., x; Milligan, NTD, 50), β. ἑαυτόν: [[mark 13 9|Mrk.13:9;]] before ἵνα μή, II Jo 8; β. ἀπό, [[mark 8 15|Mrk.8:15 12:38]]; before μή (cl. ὁρᾶν), with fut. indic., [[colossians 2 8|Col.2:8]], [[hebrews 3 12|Heb.3:12]]; id. with aor. subj., [[matthew 24 4|Mat.24:4]], [[mark 13 5|Mrk.13:5]]. 3. Of situation and direction (Lat. specto), to look, face (towards), places, etc. (before πρός, Xen, Hell., vii, 1, 17; [[ezekiel 40 23|Eze.40:23, 24]]): before κατά, with accusative, [[acts 27 12|Act.27:12]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐμ-, ἐπι-, περ-, προ-βλέπω), see DCG, i, 446; ii, 596. (AS)
βλητέος, -α, -ον (gerundive of βάλλω), (that which) one must put: [[luke 5 38|Luk.5:38.]]† (AS)
Βοανηργές, indecl. (on the derivation, see Dalman, Gr., 144; Words, 42; Swete, Mk., l.with; DCG, i, 216), Boanerges: [[mark 3 17|Mrk.3:17.]]† (AS)

βοάω, -ῶ (βοή), [in LXX chiefly for זעק, צעק, קרא ;] 1. absol., to cry, call out: [[matthew 3 3|Mat.3:3, 27:46]], [[mark 1 3|Mrk.1:3 15:34]], [[luke 3 4|Luk.3:4 9:38 18:38]], [[john 1 23|Jhn.1:23]], [[acts 8 7|Act.8:7 17:6 25:24]], [[galatians 4 27|Gal.4:27]]. 2. C. dative, to call on for help (Heb. זעק על, [[hosea 7 14|Hos.7:14]], al.), [[luke 18 7|Luk.18:7]].† SYN.: καλέω, to call, invite, summon; κράζω, to cry, harshly or inarticulately, as animals; κραυγάζω, intensive of κράζω. βοάω expresses emotion, whether joy, fear, etc. (AS)
βοή, -ῆς, ἡ, [in LXX for זְעָקָה, etc. ;] a cry: [[james 5 4|Jas.5:4.]]† (AS)

βοήθεια, -ας, ἡ (see: βοηθέω), [in LXX for עֵזֶר, etc. ;] help: [[hebrews 4 16|Heb.4:16;]] pl., helps, "frapping," a technical nautical term (MM, Exp., x; DB, ext., 367): [[acts 27 17|Act.27:17.]]† (AS)

βοηθέω, -ῶ (βοή + θέω, to run), [in LXX chiefly for עזר ;] to come to aid, to help, succour: absol., [[acts 21 28|Act.21:28;]] with dative, [[matthew 15 25|Mat.15:25]], [[mark 9 22|Mrk.9:22, 24]] [[acts 16 9|Act.16:9]], [[2-corinthians 6 2|2Co.6:2]]" (LXX), [[hebrews 2 18|Heb.2:18]], [[revelation 12 16|Rev.12:16]].† (AS)
βοηθός, -ον (see: βοηθέω), [in LXX chiefly for עזר ;] 1. (poët. -όος), hasting to the war-cry (Hom.). 2. helping, auxiliary; as subst. (Hdt.), a helper: [[hebrews 13 6|Heb.13:6]] (LXX). † (AS)
βόθυνος, -ου, ὁ (= βόθρος, more frequently in cl.), [in LXX chiefly for פַּחַת ;] a pit: [[matthew 12 11|Mat.12:11 15:14]], [[luke 6 39|Luk.6:39]] (cf. DB, iii, 885; DCG, ii, 367).† (AS)
